title: SeasonRainBench: Global Seasonal Precipitation
abstract: arXiv:2611.22281v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate seasonal precipitation forecasts help societies prepare for drought, flooding, and crop failure months in advance. While data-driven methods have made rapid progress in weather and subseasonal forecasting, operational seasonal precipitation prediction still relies on numerical ensemble systems. These systems are computationally expensive and exhibit biases and drift that increase with lead time, motivating more efficient data-driven alternatives. Yet this transition faces three linked challenges: comparing data-driven forecasts with operational ones requires (1) a global benchmark that does not exist, scoring them requires (2) metrics that capture operational priorities beyond anomaly correlation (ACC) and RMSE, and training them must (3) rely on a single, short observational record. To address the first two challenges, we introduce \BenchName, the first such benchmark, covering monthly precipitation forecasts 1--5 months ahead.

translated_abstract: 准确的季节性降水预报可以帮助社会提前数月为干旱、洪水和农作物歉收做好准备。尽管数据驱动方法在天气和次季节预报领域取得了快速进展，但业务化的季节性降水预测仍然依赖于数值集合预报系统。这些系统计算成本高昂，且存在随预报时效增加而不断增大的偏差和漂移，这促使人们寻求更高效的数据驱动替代方案。然而，这一转型面临三个相互关联的挑战：将数据驱动预报与业务预报进行比较需要（1）一个目前尚不存在的全球基准；对其进行评分需要（2）超越异常相关系数（ACC）和均方根误差（RMSE）、能够体现业务优先事项的评估指标；而训练数据驱动模型则必须（3）依赖单一且时间跨度较短的观测记录。为了解决前两个挑战，我们提出了SeasonRainBench——首个此类基准，涵盖未来1至5个月的月度降水预报。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个全球季节性降水预报基准SeasonRainBench，涵盖未来1至5个月的月度降水预报，并引入超越ACC和RMSE、体现业务需求的评估指标，以弥合数据驱动方法与业务数值集合预报系统之间的评估差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SeasonRainBench, the first global benchmark for seasonal precipitation forecasting covering monthly forecasts 1–5 months ahead, along with operationally-oriented evaluation metrics beyond ACC and RMSE, to enable fair comparison between data-driven methods and operational numerical ensemble systems.
